def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    order=cnt.most_common()
    b2=order[1][0]
    # frame bbox from cells equal to frame color
    fr=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==b2]
    top=min(p[0] for p in fr); bot=max(p[0] for p in fr)
    left=min(p[1] for p in fr); right=max(p[1] for p in fr)
    def g(r,c): return I[r][c] if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W else None
    cTL=g(top-1,left-1); cTR=g(top-1,right+1)
    cBL=g(bot+1,left-1); cBR=g(bot+1,right+1)
    # specials: any value in frame bbox not equal bg or frame color, excluding frame-border cells
    for r in range(top,bot+1):
        for c in range(left,right+1):
            if I[r][c] not in (bg,b2): O[r][c]=bg
    # map each special value to the diagonal-opposite outside corner cell of the frame
    # specials positions known: compute per special
    specs=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(top,bot+1) for c in range(left,right+1) if I[r][c] not in (bg,b2)]

    for r,c,v in specs:
        nr = (bot+1) if r<cr else (top-1)

        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W: O[nr][nc]=v
